# Women’s Shootout

> A women’s road cycling community in Tucson, Arizona. Saturday morning group rides on the Shootout route, plus a Strava club and email list.

Women’s Shootout (WSO) is a community road ride for women, trans, and femme cyclists with prior road and group-riding experience. It is distinct from the co-ed Shootout ride organized around Fair Wheel Bikes, though WSO rides with Fair Wheel’s blessing. The ride is free and is not a no-drop ride.

## Rides

- Every Saturday in Tucson.
- Most Saturdays start at the MSA Annex, 267 S. Avenida del Convento.
- Second Saturday of each month starts at University Avenue and Euclid Avenue (845 E. University Boulevard for GPS).
- A group averages about 18–20 mph. A B group of about 15–17 mph rides when leaders are available.
- Start times change seasonally. Confirm the current Strava event before leaving home.

- [Rides and Events](https://laurendahlin1.github.io/womens-shootout/more-events/): Upcoming WSO rides, sister-club events, and Arizona racing.
- [Contact](https://laurendahlin1.github.io/womens-shootout/contact/): Questions and ride-leader notes.
